page_script_syntax.command: extract page script from page.go and run node --check

page_script_runtime.command: extract formatTime from page.go and execute with Node

known_limits: 未执行 Windows 构建、Windows 现场运行或图形界面验收，由总控负责。
未执行真实腾讯云设备接口端到端联调，依赖服务端工程师按 required_server_contract 完成并部署。
页面已通过 Go 接口测试、JavaScript 语法检查和日志时间格式运行验证，本阶段未执行真实浏览器验收。

event_upload.auth: device Bearer plus Ed25519 request signature
event_upload.idempotency: duplicate event_id retries are accepted idempotently; a rejected batch must not be partially persisted

platform_events.auth: device Bearer plus Ed25519 request signature
platform_events.device_scope: derive tenant and connector from device identity; return only the authenticated connector
platform_events.strict_body: do not add top-level tenant_id, connector_id, received_at or origin to the device response; origin is assigned by the server and exposed only in the admin view

validation: validate schema_version, event_id, occurred_at, levels, components and catalog event codes
accept rpc_error_code only as a canonical decimal string from -32700 through -32000
validate that tool_name belongs to the approved set for its source
never accept or persist free-form details, headers, bodies, arguments, results, URLs or environment values
required_server_contract.retention: server enforces 14-day retention and connector/global event limits
